lines.en: Priya, my lawyer told me not to sign anything until he had read the whole contract. He was very clear about it.
lines.pt: Priya, meu advogado me disse para não assinar nada até ele ler o contrato inteiro. Ele foi muito claro.

lines.en: Wise advice. The salesman asked me to sign the rental agreement today, and he warned me that the price would go up tomorrow.
lines.pt: Conselho sábio. O vendedor me pediu para assinar o contrato de aluguel hoje e me avisou que o preço subiria amanhã.

lines.en: That is a pressure tactic. I asked him whether the fee could be cancelled, and he said it could not.
lines.pt: Isso é uma tática de pressão. Perguntei se a taxa podia ser cancelada, e ele disse que não.

lines.en: Then I’ll tell him I need a few days. My brother advised me to read every clause twice.
lines.pt: Então vou dizer a ele que preciso de alguns dias. Meu irmão me aconselhou a ler cada cláusula duas vezes.

lines.en: Good. Ask him to send the document by email, and tell him you will call back on Monday.
lines.pt: Ótimo. Peça a ele para enviar o documento por e-mail e diga que você ligará na segunda.

lines.en: He wanted to know why I was hesitating. I explained that I had made a mistake once before.
lines.pt: Ele quis saber por que eu estava hesitando. Expliquei que já tinha cometido um erro uma vez.

lines.en: Did he agree to wait? When I questioned a hidden fee last year, the manager refused to discuss it.
lines.pt: Ele concordou em esperar? Quando questionei uma taxa escondida no ano passado, o gerente se recusou a discutir.

lines.en: He offered me a small discount, but I told him not to rush me. Was that too rude?
lines.pt: Ele me ofereceu um pequeno desconto, mas eu disse a ele para não me apressar. Foi grosseiro demais?

lines.en: Not at all. My lawyer says people should never sign under pressure, and that a good company will wait.
lines.pt: De jeito nenhum. Meu advogado diz que as pessoas nunca devem assinar sob pressão e que uma boa empresa espera.

lines.en: I’ll take the contract home and ask my colleague to check it. She works in legal.
lines.pt: Vou levar o contrato para casa e pedir à minha colega para conferir. Ela trabalha na área jurídica.

lines.en: Perfect. Remind her to look at the cancellation terms, and tell her I said hello.
lines.pt: Perfeito. Lembre-a de olhar os termos de cancelamento e diga a ela que mandei um oi.

facts.label: Cautela com contratos
facts.sub: He told me not to sign. She asked me to send it. He warned me that the price would go up. I asked whether it could be cancelled.

facts.label: told me to / not to
facts.sub: Use told + pessoa + to + verbo para repetir ordens ou conselhos: He told me to wait. Para o negativo, use not to: He told me not to sign anything. Não use said + pessoa.

facts.label: asked me to
facts.sub: Use asked + pessoa + to + verbo para pedidos: She asked me to send the document. Outros verbos úteis: advised, warned, reminded. Todos seguem a mesma ordem.

compare.ask: He told me not to sign anything.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “ele me disse para não assinar nada”.
compare.tip: Diga: “He told me not to sign anything.”
compare.us: Em inglês, usamos told + pessoa + (not) to + verbo: He told me not to sign anything.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Told me not to sign is a reported command.
We say “He told me to not signing”.
items.why: We say He told me not to sign.

items.s: Asked me to send is followed by to + verb.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Told me not to sign is a reported command. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “He told me to not signing”. → Falso (We say He told me not to sign.)
Asked me to send is followed by to + verb. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: Signing a contract · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Monday morning in Seattle. Dawn and Clara share a quiet office. Clara has a thick contract on her desk. A salesman wants an answer today. Dawn remembers her lawyer’s warning. The two women lower their voices.

“Clara, my lawyer told me not to sign anything until he had read the whole contract. He was very clear about it.” says Dawn. “Wise advice. The salesman asked me to sign the rental agreement today, and he warned me that the price would go up tomorrow.” says Clara. “That is a pressure tactic. I asked him whether the fee could be cancelled, and he said it could not.” says Dawn.
